Name: Kelcey
Review: Dr. Tichy is a family man and is very personable and is genuinely interested in providing quality service over quantity. The office is small, comfortable, and very clean. When you are there you feel important because the dentist isn't running from chair to chair to chair, you receive quality one on one time and because of that your time isn't wasted on "wait time". I really enjoyed the screen on the ceiling, Dr. Tichy is very good at explaining things and answering any questions you have. I felt very comfortable and left understanding the inside of my mouth in ways I had never before. Dr. Tichy is great I highly recommend his office.

Name: Chris L.
Review: Dr. Tichy and his staff were friendly, helpful, informative, efficient, and professional. His office is very high tech in a good way. Cleaning was easier and faster than the manual method of the past. There is a monitor on the ceiling so you can follow along with any procedures. It's a small thing, but he even seemed to know just when to stop and say "You can swallow now." That wasn't always the case in the past. I am very impressed with his service and am actually looking forward to my next visit.

Name: Jeff M.
Review: Dr. Tichy and his staff are fantastic! When you're in the office, it's obvious that they truly care about your experience. A good dentist is hard to find, we feel fortunate that we found a great one!!

Name: Linda R.
Review: Dr. Tichy and his staff were great. I had broken a tooth and he was able to get me in first thing the next morning. Even though it was snowing and the roads were bad his staff still came in and took care of me. He was very good at explaining everything that was being done, while placing a permanent crown on my tooth. Thank you so much. I would highly recommend Dr. Tichy.

Name: Lisa M.
Review: Practice was purchased by Dr. Tichy and I was a long time patient of the former dentist. Glad I stayed on. Dr. Tichy is great; hands on, cool new equipment, friendly and great communication with patient. Updates to office and staff continue as he and his wife grow their practice. They are a welcome addition to the community. I definitely recommend!

Name: Bonita J.
Review: If you're looking for a new dentist I highly recommend Dr. Tichy! Great dentist with state of the art equipment. Very friendly staff.

Name: Christopher B.
Review: Dr. Tichy is an incredibly personable and warm dentist. He goes the extra mile to take great care of his patients and to make certain that they are both comfortable and that they understand their care. I even entrust him with my mom and would recommend him to anyone who is looking for a caring and competent dentist.

Name: Brendan P.
Review: Tichy Dental is everything I had hoped for when looking for a dentist. I hadn't had a primary dentist in years, but he's as honest to his word as anyone else I've been with. No qualms whatsoever!

Name: Marlon O.
Review: Been going same place since I was child 43 plus years later it was sold to Tichy but I tell you nice couple very friendly and excellent service with up to date new equipment makes cleaning process and all the necessary dental work much more enjoyable, so if your an old patient here you'll love new the doc and staff. Funny thing is I have a dentist one block from my house but I'd rather drive and give my business to them, support the whole ma and pa business rather than a dental franchise.

Name: Amy S.
Review: Dr. Tichy is efficient and comfortable to chat with - my appointments are always quick, easy and painless.

Name: Google reviewer
Review: Dr. Tichy is a great dentist. He is very professional. He also has a very pleasing personality putting you at ease while you are in his chair. His office is up to date with new equipment and technology. He is knowledgeable in his field and gets the work done efficiently. Thank you Dr Tichy. I highly recommend.

Name: Jaycee H.
Review: Great dentist, great staff. I definitely recommend trying this dental office!

Name: Jim J.
Review: Dr. Tichy is an excellent dentist, and he and his staff offer great customer service. His equipment is modern and his professional, and friendly service is second to none. Both my wife and I will continue to have all our dental work done at Tichy Dental.

Name: JR M.
Review: Love Dr Tichy. He is so friendly and always asks about the family. Makes it personal and is very in depth with teeth care. Strongly recommend the whole family to him.

Name: Jim S.
Review: Dr Tichy is a great dentist! Very thorough, takes time to explain and has a great staff.

Name: Alexis L.
Review: Had the best experience at Tichy Dental! The doctor gave me a great, gentle, cleaning and even got my 5 and 2 year olds to sit still long enough for a thorough exam and cleaning. The front office personnel are so lovely and helped with my children while I was in the back. Absolutely would recommend Tichy Dental in West Linn. :)

Name: Teresa O.
Review: Dr. Tichy and his staff are fabulous. They made me feel comfortable and well taken care of at his practice. I will actually look forward to going to the dentist again!

Name: Miluse L.
Review: Dr. Tichy and his staff are excellent! Everyone at this dental office is kind, thorough, and caring. I highly recommend them. Easy to make appointments, convenient location, nice facility. Thank you, Dr. Tichy, for saving several of my teeth and making them look good!

Name: Dianne K.
Review: Dr Tichy and staff are very nice, the office is pleasant.

Name: Harrie K.
Review: The Staff and Dr. Tichy were excellent. I needed a crown for a crack in my back molar and it was taken care of quickly and painlessly. When I came back to have the permanent crown installed the color was matched perfectly and you can't tell it from my own teeth. I came back for a couple of small cavities and they also were taken care of quickly and painlessly. I applaud Dr. Tichy and his entire staff for excellent work and would implore everyone to come here for the caring, professional work done!
